plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: brand seal anchors the far left, the round tin sits beside it, a wide copy block carries the headline, and the NEW HARVEST tag sits stacked just above a strong right-hand CTA so the badge travels with the action.

Product-first with a brand sign-off: the tin opens the strip, the NEW HARVEST tag leads into the headline like a kicker, copy fills the middle, then the CTA and the Quillbrook seal close the read on the right.
Headline-led: the copy block opens flush left so the message is read first, then the tin is shown as the product payoff, followed by the badge, the CTA and a small brand seal at the far right end.
